recognize_zh: 視野中兩個延長、兩端圓鈍的香蕉／臘腸形寄生蟲，胞體內佈滿紫紅色染色質與散在的暗色瘧色素，被感染的紅血球輪廓幾乎看不到、且不比周圍紅血球大；這種新月形配子體（gametocyte）是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的特徵。
features: Two elongated, banana- to sausage-shaped gametocytes with rounded ends, longer than the diameter of a normal red cell
Granular purple-magenta chromatin distributed through the parasite with scattered dark malarial pigment
Host red cell membrane barely discernible and not enlarged; no Schüffner stippling
Possible small marginal (accolé) parasite at the edge of a red cell at left; asexual forms otherwise inconspicuous
Background red cells normocytic with numerous crenated forms (echinocytes, likely artifact); no white cells in field
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear (Field stain, oil immersion) shows two elongated, crescent/sausage-shaped intraerythrocytic parasites with rounded ends, granular chromatin and dispersed dark pigment, which distort and exceed the length of the host red cell without enlarging it. No Schüffner dots or enlarged infected cells are present. The background red cells are normocytic with numerous echinocytes, likely a preparation artifact. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes; a parasitemia count and search for ring forms should accompany the report.

ddx.vs: Non-falciparum gametocytes are round to oval, fill an enlarged red cell and are accompanied by Schüffner stippling, not banana-shaped.
Band forms stretch across a normal-sized red cell as a narrow bar within the cell outline, whereas falciparum gametocytes exceed and distort the red cell length.
Babesia forms small pleomorphic rings and tetrads (Maltese cross) without pigment or gametocytes.

ddx.dx: Platelet overlying a red cell or stain precipitate
ddx.vs: Platelets and stain debris lack the defined elongated parasite outline, organized chromatin and pigment, and lie in a different focal plane.
